global_caption: The video contains 10 shots. It is a 15-second Chinese-language advertising short film in cyberpunk high-saturation Eastern fairyland style, unified by vivid blue-purple-cyan neon tones blending warm and cool hues. Lighting features soft ambient glow from cloud seas and neon edge highlights along product contours. Emotional tone remains consistently grand and uplifting with a touch of dreaminess.
shot1: Shot 1 opens directly with a wide overhead tracking shot gliding over neon clouds, floating palaces, and fairy mountains. Foreground features flowing clouds, distant palaces forming depth leading lines, focus on massive illuminated text "高速气流" spanning across the mountain mid-frame. Text floats slightly above center, made of semi-transparent glass-like material overlaid with neon current, edges emitting particles. The scene overlays cybernetic patterns onto the Eastern fairyland base. Blue-purple lighting defines mountain silhouettes. An elephant with glowing mane emerges from clouds to establish subject identity.
shot2: Shot 2 hard cut from previous shot, medium close-up eye-level composition places elephant and hair dryer side-by-side slightly right of center. Foreground features glowing railings, background blurred palace light strips. Shallow depth of field focuses on elephant's raised trunk tip and device button. Elephant appears confident; trunk tip touches button, instantly activating the hair dryer. A cyan-white light trail sequentially activates the sleek body outline, neon edge glow slides along casing.
shot3: Shot 3 brief flash-white transition from previous shot, extreme close-up low-angle view of outlet and long hair behind elephant’s ear. Composition places outlet in left foreground, glowing hair on right. Background darkened into blue-purple mist to emphasize airflow. Focus locked on high-speed blue-purple wind stream and lifted fine hair strands. Hair surface transitions from fluffy to neatly lifted, tiny downy hairs and particles fly along airflow direction. each drum hit aligns with moment hair is lifted. Camera maintains extreme proximity and slowly pushes along airflow direction.
shot4: Shot 4 hard cut followed by medium shot eye-level dolly to a suspended jade bridge. Bridge surface reflects neon light, foreground passes hanging lamps creating motion sense. Subject elephant stands center, hair dryer aimed at side-back long hair. Originally slightly curly hair gradually straightens, aligns, and hangs vertically under airflow. Dense typography "强劲不打结" appears on right to lower-center, composed of glowing metallic wires, tightly arranged but with breathable edges. Text forms rapidly from wind-born particles. Camera performs stable lateral dolly, fully showcasing smooth hair effect in space.
shot5: Shot 5 soft fade-in/fade-out transition from previous shot, medium-long overhead view of mirror-like water surface. Symmetrical composition: upper half real subject, lower half reflection. Focus shifts from silky water reflection to actual hair. Environment remains same palace courtyard, only viewpoint elevated. Water reflects blue-purple neon and divine light. Hair after blow-drying shows smooth luster, bright lines in reflection glide like silk. Highlights product shine feature. Camera slowly tilts down, emphasizing mirror effect and texture.
shot6: Shot 6 hard cut into extreme close-up, focusing on tail hair details. Composition diagonally crosses frame, hair dryer outlet at bottom-left indicating direction. Background blurred into flowing blue-purple bokeh. Focus on tail hair fibers transitioning from slightly damp to rapidly separating, drying, and becoming lightweight. Tiny moisture carried away by airflow, residual light spots on hair shift from dull to bright. Camera slowly zooms in macro-style, enhancing credibility of quick-dry effect.
shot7: Scene returns to platform before floating palace. Cluster lights illuminate hair dryer casing outline sequentially, like sketching a streamlined product sculpture in darkness. Foreground features translucent drifting mist, background layered halls and neon eaves. Elephant positioned left as scale reference, product floats right-center, showing full form and premium quality. Lighting still relies on edge neon outlines and cloud sea reflections. Camera slowly pulls back and slightly tilts up.
shot8: Shot 8 transition via beam sweep across screen, extreme close-up overhead-to-eye-level approach to outlet. Blue-purple particles swirl around vortex and form particle text in upper-right area. Text visible but unobtrusive, appearing as if written by airflow itself—functional hint. Particle flow spirals along air channel path, demonstrating high-speed stable output.
shot9: Shot 9 hard cut back to subject performance, medium-close eye-level slightly low angle. Elephant turns head in front of palace light curtain. Composition emphasizes head and swinging smooth hair strands. Foreground features floating light particles, background light strips blurred into soft bokeh. Focus locked on turning gaze and arc of swung hair. Hair forms smooth continuous ripples in air, no tangles, ends reflect silk-like highlight. Action completes transition from still glance to light swing display. Camera first slightly follows turn, then smoothly dollies half-step.
shot10: Shot 10 brief freeze followed by fade-in to final branding shot, wide full-frame frontal static shot centered at main palace gate. Hair dryer floats centrally, casing fully outlined by cluster lights and edge glow. Elephant with glowing mane stands aside, establishing brand worldview memory point. Foreground mist low-lying, background halls steadily glowing, forming solemn symmetrical composition. Focus clearly on product and main copy. Large text "轻、快、顺" appears center-lower, font has 3D glowing gold-glass texture, outer edge with cyan-purple electric tracing. Text flashes from small to large, then stabilizes. Small auxiliary light points orbit around device. Camera makes extremely slight push-in then freezes to end.
